To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the key elements of inter‐professional teamwork are collegial support, the transgressing of professional roles and an inclusive atmosphere.
inter‐professional learning in surgical operating theatres is promoted by collegial support and transgressing professional boundaries.
inter‐professional collaboration in the OT is based on the practices of collegial support, role‐transgressing and inclusive atmosphere.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how to promote inter‐professional learning within a hospital organisation.
the question of how the practices of surgical operations can be improved in order to support inter‐professional collaboration and learning.
the question of how to develop and support inter‐professional teamwork in the surgical OT.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
inter‐professional learning is not a matter of individual skills or knowledge but a matter of shared practices.
inter‐professional learning is not a simple task, but rather a complex and demanding challenge.
inter‐professional learning is not only an educational but also a practical and social issue.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
inter‐professional learning is a complex phenomenon that cannot be reduced to the formal educational setting but should be understood in the context of everyday work.
the surgical operating theatre is a complex and dynamic social space in which the participants are required to be competent in both their professional and interpersonal skills.
inter‐professional learning in the OTs can be promoted by collegial support and by transgressing professional boundaries.
The main takeaway from our work is that
inter‐professional learning in the OT is possible, but it requires the development of new practices.
the surgical operating theatre is an environment in which learning is not only a matter of acquiring new knowledge, skills and competences.
inter‐professional learning can be fostered by creating an atmosphere where the participants feel safe to ask questions and to learn from one another.
